rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS02-L1-ADMISSION admits local proxy and remote WSS hosts with idempotent registration
rows.expectedRed: The transport package exposes no App Server host registry behavior.
rows.observableGreen: Valid local and remote hosts register once, exact replay returns the same summary, conflicting host reuse fails with no state change, and read summaries omit credential references.
rows.isolationCleanup: No process, socket, timer, secret, or file is created by admission-only behavior.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS02-L1-SECURITY rejects plaintext, embedded credentials, raw-secret fields, and unsafe local sockets
rows.observableGreen: Remote endpoints require WSS without userinfo, query, or fragment; local socket paths are absolute; raw token-shaped fields and invalid credential references fail closed without echoing values.
rows.isolationCleanup: Every rejection preserves an empty registry and serializable errors contain no supplied secret.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS02-L1-VERSION-CAPABILITY-DISABLE fails closed on incompatible hosts and disables active connections
rows.expectedRed: No version/capability admission or disabled state exists.
rows.observableGreen: Only the pinned protocol and declared capability set are admitted; disable closes active clients once and blocks later connect and health calls.
rows.isolationCleanup: All controlled clients are closed and the disabled host retains no active connection.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS02-L1-CONNECT-ROUTING routes local proxy and remote WSS through CAS-01 without leaking secrets
rows.observableGreen: Local hosts use codex app-server proxy; remote hosts use the Bun WSS-to-JSONL bridge; the resolved token exists only in the child environment and never in argv, summaries, or errors.
rows.isolationCleanup: Controlled clients close and captured connector invocations retain no secret after the assertion scope.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] CAS02-L1-RECONNECT bounds overload retry and restores unique subscriptions after reconnect
rows.expectedRed: No connection lifecycle, retry classification, or subscription restoration exists.
rows.observableGreen: Explicit server overload is retried with bounded exponential delay; reconnect is bounded with jitter; each stable subscription key is replayed once; ambiguous disconnects never replay semantic requests.
rows.isolationCleanup: Superseded clients close, timers settle, and one final controlled client remains until explicit close.

rows.testIdentity: [L2:INTEGRATION] CAS02-L2-LOCAL-DAEMON-PROXY connects through a managed daemon and recovers after restart
rows.expectedRed: The installed daemon is available but no host transport can start, proxy, health-check, or reconnect it.
rows.observableGreen: An isolated managed daemon starts, CAS-01 initializes through stdio proxy, restart breaks the old connection, bounded reconnect restores service, disable closes it, and the daemon is stopped by the fixture.
rows.isolationCleanup: Temporary CODEX_HOME, daemon, proxy children, sockets, timers, and files return to the pre-test inventory.

rows.testIdentity: [L2:INTEGRATION] CAS02-L2-REMOTE-WSS-AUTH-TLS connects to a real authenticated App Server behind TLS
rows.expectedRed: A real authenticated App Server listener can run, but no secure WSS bridge or credential-reference path exists.
rows.observableGreen: A generated trusted test CA terminates TLS, the bridge sends Authorization Bearer during upgrade, correct credentials initialize the real App Server, and wrong credentials fail with an owned redacted error.
rows.isolationCleanup: App Server, TLS proxy, bridge children, token/certificate files, sockets, and temporary homes return to zero.

rows.testIdentity: [L2:INTEGRATION] CAS02-L2-REMOTE-RECONNECT restores one subscription after real App Server restart
rows.expectedRed: No bounded WSS restart/reconnect or idempotent subscription restoration exists.
rows.observableGreen: A real authenticated App Server process exits and returns on the same endpoint; reconnect backs off within its bound and restores one stable subscription exactly once without replaying an ambiguous semantic request.
rows.isolationCleanup: Both App Server incarnations, TLS proxy, bridge children, wait timers, files, and sockets return to zero.

l3.reason: Host admission and transport behavior is fully observable through provider contracts and real local/remote L2 boundaries.
